changes.before: The Committee anticipates that it will be appropriate to raise the target range for the federal funds rate when it has seen further improvement in the labor market
changes.after: The Committee anticipates that it will be appropriate to raise the target range for the federal funds rate when it has seen some further improvement in the labor market

changes.before: The pace of job gains picked up while the unemployment rate remained steady.
changes.after: The labor market continued to improve, with solid job gains and declining unemployment.

changes.before: On balance, a range of labor market indicators suggests that underutilization of labor resources diminished somewhat.
changes.after: On balance, a range of labor market indicators suggests that underutilization of labor resources has diminished since early this year.

changes.before: the housing sector has shown some improvement
changes.after: the housing sector has shown additional improvement

changes.before: Information received since the Federal Open Market Committee met in April suggests that economic activity has been expanding moderately after having changed little during the first quarter.
changes.after: Information received since the Federal Open Market Committee met in June indicates that economic activity has been expanding moderately in recent months.

changes.before: decreasing prices of non-energy imports; energy prices appear to have stabilized.

parsed.rationale: Adding "some" before "further improvement" lowers the labor-market bar for liftoff, and the labor and activity descriptions are stronger, signaling a nearer rate hike. The removal of the note that energy prices had stabilized is a minor dovish offset, and the policy setting is otherwise unchanged.
